hermeticity.method: Focus-only baselines were built from 100:3 and its two branch inventories, then context_root_cues were evaluated in packet order as possible activators. The run uses the assigned comparison profile gpt-5.5/high rather than the packet prompt's canonical gpt-5.6-sol/max requirement.
hermeticity.limitations: This is reconstructed from a sealed packet containing focus and context together, so the trace records abductive movement rather than a strict blind staged discovery log. No tafsir, gold readings, previous outputs, or online sources were consulted.

baseline_models.mechanism: The participial plural supplies agents; غ ي ر supplies alteration/substitution, while ص ب ح supplies the morning-raid alarm. Focus-only, the line reads as agents whose arrival at dawn changes a situation.

discarded_or_unchanged: غ ي ر/root_001119/B004 protective jealousy over family remained too socially specific for 100:3 unless forced through 100:8 desire; it produced no distinct changed reading beyond possessiveness.
ص ب ح/root_000839/B007 morning sleep and B008 morning-staying camel were interesting reversals but did not attach to مُغِيرَٰتِ with enough mechanism.
و ر ي/root_001642/B001 disease eating the hollow did not create a focus-anchored model; the later chest/interior cues were better served by ح ص ل and ص د ر.
ض ب ح/root_000901/B003-B005 burning, blackening, and ash overlapped the stronger spark-plus-dust model without changing the focus differently.

ج م ع/root_000259 branches for sexual connection, pregnancy retention, hand-to-neck binding, and obscure palm categories were not used because they did not alter 100:3 beyond the center-of-gathering mechanism.
ر ب ب/root_000537/B003 usurious increase was noted under the split mapping but not retained; 100:8's love of good changed the focus without needing that legal-economic branch.

strongest_changes: 100:1 strengthens مُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا as the arrival-point of a panting, running sequence.
100:2 revises dawn into ignition: hidden fire is struck out, then morning becomes visible transformation.
100:4-5 make the focus causal and spatial: it leaves dust/traces and enters the center of a gathered mass.
100:6-10 internalize and eschatologize the image: external dawn-change becomes human severance, testimony, and final disclosure of hidden interiors.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root غ ي ر is unusually fertile: its branch inventory supports martial alteration, otherness, legal substitution, and provision/repair. The context first drives the martial sequence hard, then reopens moral, evidentiary, and non-martial readings rather than allowing one consensus image to swallow the rest.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the action-chain should be treated as one continuous agent-sequence or as separate oath-images remains an inference.
The provisioning/earth-repair model is anchored but branch-distant, especially through خ ب ر's material earth branches.
The legal-compensation outlier is valid as activation but too distant to render without explicit containment.
